scope: Internal HTTP failure handling and Sepolia fixture review; not an independent audit
finding: A funded disposable-account attempt reached one approval, signature and submission attempt, but the provider returned an HTTP failure. The previous error omitted the HTTP status; its exact status and delivery outcome are unknown.
changes: HTTP failures expose only the known RPC method and numeric status; response bodies are cancelled without being read or copied to errors
JSON-RPC error reporting remains limited to method and safe numeric provider code
Fresh fixture accounts use PublicNode for exactly one submission after checking its chain ID; Tenderly still supplies genesis and canonical-block state inspection
Existing uncertain transactions are never resubmitted or automatically failed over to another endpoint
nativeSource: Unchanged from v0.3.0-alpha.1; no additional simulator or device checks
qualification: Fresh PublicNode submission still requires real testnet confirmation
